scenes.narration_en: Just before midnight, around 11:30 p.m., rain hammered the loading yard at Hai Yen Port on Thanh Lam Street. In a narrow gap between two rows of silent containers lay Trinh Quang Vu, the forty-eight-year-old director of Sao Bien Shipping Company. He was already dead.

A single fatal wound to the back of his neck, made by something sharp. The person who found him was Dang Thu Ha, his thirty-six-year-old chief accountant. She had ridden her motorbike back to the office to pick up the financial ledgers, and walked straight into the scene.
Shaking, she called the police duty desk. Her voice cracked as she described a figure in a dark jacket sprinting through the port gate and vanishing into the pouring rain. Who was that figure?
